settings.text: As Walt Disney famously said, “I only hope that we never lose sight of one thing — that it was all started by a mouse.” Mickey Mouse is the heart of the Disney story, and his adventures span all six Disney Parks across the world — in California, Florida, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Tokyo, and Paris. Each destination invites you to step into a new chapter of your own storybook journey.

Every great story has a beginning, and for Disney Parks, it began here. Disneyland Resort is home to two iconic parks — Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure Park — where Mickey Mouse continues to welcome guests into the world he helped inspire. This is the chapter where the magic first unfolds and sets the stage for the adventures to come.

The largest Disney Resort in the world, Walt Disney World is a multi-chapter epic. With four theme parks — Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Disney’s Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom — plus two water parks, there are endless ways to experience Mickey and his friends. Each park is its own chapter, offering a new world, a new adventure, and new memories waiting to be written.

The second Disney Park to open in Asia, Hong Kong Disneyland blends classic magic with unique storytelling. Discover attractions found nowhere else, such as Big Grizzly Mountain Runaway Mine Cars and Mystic Manor.
In 2020, the park unveiled its transformed centrepiece — the Castle of Magical Dreams, inspired by 13 beloved Disney Princesses and Queens. The resort also features its own train line and three onsite Disney Hotels.

The only Disney Resort in Europe invites you into two enchanting parks — Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park (soon to be Disney Adventure World). Here, Mickey Mouse brings a distinctly European flair to your storybook journey, surrounded by charming villages, romantic architecture, and cinematic magic.

Tokyo Disney Resort features two extraordinary parks — Tokyo Disneyland and Tokyo DisneySea — each offering its own world of imagination. Tokyo Disneyland opened in 1983 as the first Disney Park in Asia, while Tokyo DisneySea is celebrated as one of the most beautifully designed theme parks in the world.
The resort is also home to eight official Disney Hotels, including the stunning Fantasy Springs Hotel, which opened in 2024 alongside the brand-new Fantasy Springs land at Tokyo DisneySea.

The newest chapter in the Disney Parks story, Shanghai Disneyland opened in 2016 and combines Disney storytelling with Chinese culture and innovation. It is home to the largest Disney Castle ever built — the Enchanted Storybook Castle — and features exclusive lands such as Adventure Isle, Treasure Cove, and Zootopia. Don’t miss the groundbreaking Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure, a ride that sets the scene for an unforgettable chapter.
